results.title: Rhino
results.overview: A dedicated park ranger has protected his population of critically endangered black rhinos so well that they have run out of space. Cornered by ruthless poachers, the rhinos are at risk of turning on each other. His team must implement a daring plan to move 21 rhinos across the country and open a new safe haven.

results.title: The Kim Kardashian Diamond Heist
results.overview: A look back at the robbery that targeted Kim Kardashian, during which she was gagged and robbed of $9 million worth of jewelry.

results.title: According to Otto
results.overview: Otto Brooks is 16 with a massive imagination and a big secret he’s ready to reveal – he’s gay. Otto has the usual family, parents who love and embarrass him, a Uni student sister who wants to change the world, a pop culture-loving Nana and a best friend, Max, who he’s secretly in love with. Add to that, a school bully out for blood, and Otto has a lot to go through before he becomes what he really wants, to be: out, happy, and in love. Time to delve into the world according to Otto.

results.title: Morgan: Killer Doll
results.overview: Things go awry when Astrid doesn't share the same feelings for her longtime best friend, Darcy.

results.title: The Bombshell Butcher
results.overview: Candace Higgins, a determined journalist, finds herself with the challenge of finding compelling stories amidst the mundane. A serial killer dubbed "The Bombshell Butcher" descends upon the town, offering Candace the scoop of a lifetime.

results.title: Are We Good?
results.overview: This raw, intimate portrait of comedian and podcast pioneer Marc Maron follows the sudden loss of his partner and filmmaker Lynn Shelton. Maron struggles with grief, disillusionment, and a shifting comedy landscape, processing it all through his life, both on-stage and off.

results.title: Sthlm Rififi
results.overview: Roberto and his wife Sigge have left their hectic lives behind to settle in a house in the countryside. During their daughter's 6th birthday party, the tranquility of their new life is disrupted by the arrival of Roberto’s best friend and former partner-in-crime, Teemu. With a big score in the works, Teemu is determined to pull his old friend back into the game.

results.title: Spinster
results.overview: Single, penniless poet Ruby has recently moved back home to live with her mum, Jen. When their strict Presbyterian neighbours descend on the home for her spoiled sister Eliza's engagement party, Ruby’s only job is to not shame the family...

results.title: Our Time Will Come
results.overview: Victoria and Siaka, an Austrian-Gambian couple in their mid-30s in Vienna, are in love, but being together has not been without turmoil. As they work on a relationship between two continents, the foundations are laid for their shared future as a family.

results.title: City's Laundry and Taxes
results.overview: In a small town outside of Manila in 2017, a laundromat owner's son finds his missing classmate's ID in a police uniform's dirty laundry.

results.title: Marie contre Goliath: le combat de Marie-Claude Barrette
results.original_title: Marie contre Goliath: le combat de Marie-Claude Barrette
results.overview: A fraudulent advertisement leads Marie-Claude Barrette into a legal battle against Meta. We follow her in her quest for justice, on behalf of the thousands of victims who have been defrauded.

results.title: Narivetta
results.overview: A police officer uncovers a conspiracy based around state-sanctioned violence against victimized villagers.

results.title: 7 immoral Tales
results.overview: Seven stories delve into perverse games of power, desire, and necessity. Moral dilemmas, forbidden attractions, and intimate secrets intertwine as pleasure threatens to destroy everything.

results.title: The Rise: The New MoneyBall
results.overview: An inside look at the past 50 years that led to women's professional sports becoming a billion-dollar business and a hot pop culture topic in 2024.

results.title: Whispers
results.overview: Whispers fill the silence around her, each one a subtle accusation, a reminder of guilt and blame. As a grieving mother struggles to navigate the weight of loss, the whispers grow louder. Will they ever let her find peace?

results.title: Mischievous Classmate Seina Shinomi
results.original_title: ヤンチャな同級生 篠見星奈

results.title: The Scent of Things Remembered
results.original_title: A Memória do Cheiro das Coisas
results.overview: An intimate drama about an aging war veteran forced into a retirement home, where he confronts the ghosts of his past and forms an unexpected bond with his Black caregiver.

results.title: We’ve Met
results.overview: Sad sack bartender can’t remember his customers so he takes part in a medical study for memory loss medication, only to suffer from its hidden side effects

results.title: Certains l'aiment chauve
results.overview: When Zac’s girlfriend breaks up with him because he’s going bald, he embarks on a daring quest to save his scalp and win her back, with the help of his hair-obsessed uncle.

results.title: Guided
results.overview: Guided comes from exploring African Orisha's and their connection to themes of grief and acceptance. Maya's journey is depicted through a physical representation of the deities as she comes to terms with her parents death. It's okay to navigate complex emotions and to connect spirituality with personal struggles, offering a reflection on life, death and acceptance.
